theorems.statement: ∀ (G : Type) [AddCommGroup G] [DecidableEq G] (S : Finset G), (∀ x ∈ S, -x ∈ S) → S.sum (fun x => x) = (S.filter (fun x => (2 : ℕ) • x = 0)).sum (fun x => x)
